methodologyNotes: Published self-serve pricing was collected from each provider's own pricing page on the accessed date; per-seat tiers (SurveyMonkey Team, Google Workspace) record the per-user monthly price with a note and billingModel per_seat, while single-account tiers are billingModel flat. Most providers quote the annual-billing monthly rate, recorded with annualDiscountPct null unless the page itself states a discount. Quote-only Enterprise tiers are recorded with monthlyUsd null, and minutes/calls/overage fields are null for every plan since they do not apply to survey/form software. SurveyMonkey and Google Workspace prices were corroborated against 2026 third-party pricing sources because the fetch service geo-resolved those pages to EUR; SurveySparrow figures use the consistently published entry tiers, with higher tiers marked quote-only.

vendors.provenance: https://www.surveymonkey.com/pricing/individual/ (official pricing page geo-resolved to EUR on fetch; USD figures corroborated by costbench.com and usercall.co 2026 SurveyMonkey pricing guides, accessed 2026-06-13). Paid plans charge $0.15 per response over the included limit.

plans.name: Standard Monthly
plans.notes: Single user, billed monthly with no annual commitment. Unlimited questions, 1,000 responses per month, custom design, skip logic, 200+ integrations.

plans.name: Advantage Annual
plans.notes: Single user, $39/month billed annually. Unlimited questions, 15,000 responses per year, advanced logic, payment acceptance, statistical analysis, AI-powered insights.

plans.name: Premier Annual

plans.name: Team Advantage
plans.notes: $30/user/month billed annually, minimum 3 users. Shared asset library, user roles and permissions, collaborative tools.

plans.name: Team Premier

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Quote-only, 5+ users. Advanced governance, SSO, custom data centers, premium onboarding, dedicated customer success.

vendors.name: SurveySparrow

Only the Free tier renders a confirmable price ($0); all paid tier prices load dynamically and do not render a numeric value on the live page, so Basic, Starter, Business and Enterprise are recorded with monthlyUsd null. Billing is quarterly/annual; the page advertises up to 40% annual savings but no per-plan numeric prices are shown.
